translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Davidi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi “kadi vonda”.

content.text: A buevi, beno bapfumu, mu busonga lueti yolukilanga e ?
Mu bufuana lueti sambisilanga batu e ?
Nana ! Mu mintima mieno, lueti yindula makambulu masonga
ayi mioko mieno milembo muangisa makhemi va ntoto.
Tona mu mbutukulu, batu bambimbi beti zimbala ;
tona mu vumu, ntu ngolo badi ayi bantubanga luvunu.
Mitsa miawu midi banga mitsa mi nioka,
banga kusa kizibikidi matu mandi
kinkambu wa mbembo yi batu bansakisanga zinioka ;
mbembo yi ndoki yiyenda tsangu.
Kola meno mu miunu miawu, a Nzambi ;
vuza, a Yave, meno ma zikhosi.
Bika balalakana banga maza ma nkumba !
Mu thangu bambansula mimbasa miawu,
bika madionga mawu maba makambu tsongi
banga khodi yinsiuta bu yilembo diati ;
banga muana wusuluka bika kabika mona thangu.
Tuamina zinzungu zieno zimona diamu di zitsendi
ziba zinlangu voti ziyuma,
batu bambimbi bela kombulu.
Basonga bela mona khini
bu bela mona landi kioki bela kuba vutudila ;
bela sukula malu mawu mu menga ma batu bambimbi.
Batu bela tuba :
“Bukiedika ; basonga bantambulanga mfutu mu kadika thangu.
Bukiedika vadi Nzambi weti sambisa va ntoto.”
